company.name: PRYPCO
company.shortDescription: PRYPCO is a proptech company that builds an ecosystem to facilitate access to property through mortgages and fractional ownership.
company.description: PRYPCO is a real estate technology company. It operates a digital platform that combines multiple services related to real estate, including property buying and selling, mortgage assistance, fractional property investment, and related administrative services such as residency,Golden Visa support.

productsAndServices.description: A digital marketplace for investing in tokenized Dubai real estate and physically backed gold, enabling fractional ownership and the purchase or sale of asset tokens.
productsAndServices.name: PRYPCO Mint

productsAndServices.description: A digital mortgage brokerage service that compares UAE home-loan options, provides rapid pre-approval, and supports new purchases, refinancing, and equity release.
productsAndServices.name: PRYPCO Mortgage

productsAndServices.description: A fractional real estate investment platform that enables individuals to buy shares in Dubai properties, receive rental income, and build diversified property exposure from relatively small amounts.
productsAndServices.name: PRYPCO Blocks

productsAndServices.description: A B2B platform for UAE real estate agents that provides property listings, project data, sales-offer tools, and mortgage and Golden Visa referral management.
productsAndServices.name: PRYPCO One

productsAndServices.description: A UAE residency support service that helps eligible property investors, professionals, entrepreneurs, and other qualified applicants assess eligibility and process Golden Visa applications.
productsAndServices.name: PRYPCO Golden Visa

productsAndServices.description: Real estate services supporting the purchase, sale, rental, and management of UAE properties through PRYPCO’s broader digital ecosystem.
